page.overview:
Who is Calleen?

Calleen was the Altiri goddess of wisdom. The Altiri Jedi Master Lene Kostana named her second convor, Calleen, after the goddess. Kostana asked fellow Jedi Master Dooku to look after her convor and told him the convor's name. Dooku replied that Calleen was also the name of the goddess, impressing Kostana with his knowledge.

Dooku later told his sister, Jenza, about the events in a holo-letter. Dooku gave several data disks containing his messages to Jenza to his recently recruited Sith assassin—Asajj Ventress—for her investigation into his sister's location, and she listened to the holo-disk that mentioned Calleen.

Calleen was mentioned in a flashback sequence in the audio drama Dooku: Jedi Lost, written by Cavan Scott The spelling of Calleen was confirmed by the audio drama's script release on October 1 of the same year.
